hero.title: From box to online in about 15 minutes
hero.subtitle: No technician visit, no waiting around. Follow these steps in the Xfinity app and set up your gig WiFi yourself.
intro.title: What you will need
intro.body: Your xFi Gateway ships to your door, and the Xfinity app guides you through every step. Have your phone, the Gateway, and the included cables handy, then work down the timeline below.
step-1.title: Download the Xfinity app
step-1.body: Get the free Xfinity app and sign in with your account. It becomes your setup guide, WiFi dashboard, and support line all in one place.
step-2.title: Plug in your xFi Gateway
step-2.body: Connect the Gateway to your cable outlet and power. The lights will blink while it wakes up, and the app shows you exactly which cable goes where.
step-3.title: Activate your service
step-3.body: Tap activate in the app. It connects your Gateway to the Xfinity network and turns on your gig-speed WiFi, usually in just a few minutes.
step-4.title: Name your WiFi and connect
step-4.body: Create a WiFi name and password, then connect your phone, TV, and everything else. Whole-home coverage kicks in right away.
step-5.title: Manage it all from the app
step-5.body: Turn on Advanced Security, set parental controls, and check your speeds anytime. Your rate is locked with the 5-year price guarantee, so there are no surprises later.
closing.title: That is it. You are online.
closing.body: Same-day WiFi, set up on your schedule, with a price that stays the same for five years.
